hebrews.10.p1.b1.text: For the law is only a shadow of the good things to come, not the realities themselves.

hebrews.10.p1.b2.text: It can never, by the same sacrifices offered year after year, make perfect those who draw near to worship.

hebrews.10.p1.b3.text: Instead, those sacrifices are an annual reminder of sins, because it is impossible for the blood of bulls and goats to take away sins.

hebrews.10.p2.b4.text: Therefore, when Christ came into the world, He said: “Sacrifice and offering You did not desire, but a body You prepared for Me.

hebrews.10.p2.b5.text: Then I said, ‘Here I am, it is written about Me in the scroll: I have come to do Your will, O God.’”

hebrews.10.p2.b6.text: And by that will, we have been sanctified through the sacrifice of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.

hebrews.10.p3.b7.text: Day after day every priest stands to minister and to offer again and again the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins.

hebrews.10.p3.b8.text: But when this Priest had offered for all time one sacrifice for sins, He sat down at the right hand of God.

hebrews.10.p3.b9.text: because by a single offering He has made perfect for all time those who are being sanctified.

hebrews.10.p4.b10.text: “This is the covenant I will make with them after those days, declares the Lord.

hebrews.10.p4.b11.text: I will put My laws in their hearts and inscribe them on their minds.”

hebrews.10.p4.b12.text: “Their sins and lawless acts I will remember no more.”

hebrews.10.p4.b13.text: And where these have been forgiven, an offering for sin is no longer needed.

hebrews.10.p5.b14.text: Therefore, brothers, since we have confidence to enter the Most Holy Place by the blood of Jesus,

hebrews.10.p5.b15.text: by the new and living way opened for us through the curtain of His body,

hebrews.10.p5.b16.text: let us draw near with a sincere heart in full assurance of faith, …

hebrews.10.p6.b17.text: Let us hold resolutely to the hope we profess, for He who promised is faithful.

hebrews.10.p6.b18.text: Let us not neglect meeting together, as some have made a habit,

hebrews.10.p6.b19.text: but let us encourage one another, and all the more as you see the Day approaching.

hebrews.10.p7.b20.text: If we deliberately go on sinning after we have received the knowledge of the truth, no further sacrifice for sins remains,

hebrews.10.p7.b21.text: but only a fearful expectation of judgment and of raging fire that will consume all adversaries.

hebrews.10.p7.b23.text: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

hebrews.10.p8.b24.text: Remember the early days that you were in the light. In those days, you endured a great conflict in the face of suffering.

hebrews.10.p8.b25.text: … and joyfully accepted the confiscation of your property, knowing that you yourselves had a better and permanent possession.

hebrews.10.p8.b26.text: You sympathized with those in prison …

hebrews.10.p9.b27.text: So do not throw away your confidence; it holds a great reward.

hebrews.10.p9.b28.text: For, “In just a little while, He who is coming will come and will not delay.

hebrews.10.p9.b29.text: and if he shrinks back, I will take no pleasure in him.”

hebrews.10.p9.b30.text: But we are not of those who shrink back and are destroyed, but of those who have faith and preserve their souls.
